description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure AdoNetGrainDirectory services within Orleans.Hosting. It primarily provides a method to register the GrainDirectory with specific options and validators, enabling dependency injection and configuration setup for AdoNet-based grain directory implementations.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register AdoNetGrainDirectory services within the Orleans hosting framework.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Extension method for IServiceCollection that registers and configures an AdoNetGrainDirectory with specified options and validation, enabling dependency injection within Orleans.
